name: yt-dlp
author: Misty
overview: yt-dlp brings video, playlist, and audio downloads into Misty using pinned, verified yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and FFprobe executables shipped with the extension.
capabilities: Download single YouTube videos or playlists
Convert downloads into MP3, M4A, MP4, or WEBM
Save media into sensible Music, Movies, or Downloads folders
where_it_appears: Files tabs when launched from Files
permissions: Network access through the verified bundled yt-dlp
Write access to local download folders
Shell access to invoke yt-dlp and FFmpeg
getting_started: Install yt-dlp and FFmpeg on the machine running Misty.
Open the plugin from the Plugins view or the global plugin launcher.
Paste a YouTube URL, choose MP3 or MP4, and start the download.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Added popup-first launch behavior, bridge readiness, and automatic job recovery.
v0.2.0 - Added dependency checks, URL inspection, playlist safeguards, cancellable download jobs, bounded playlists, safe command arguments, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Added the initial yt-dlp panel.
